name: PostgreSQL Plan Analyzer
description: Parse PostgreSQL EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) offline, build a collapsible plan tree, split time by loops, flag row-estimate deviations and sort spills, and surface hotspot nodes
help: Run EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON) SELECT …; in psql, then paste the JSON or open it as a file. Everything is offline — no database connection, no query execution.

Time semantics: Actual Total Time is the average milliseconds per loop, so a node contributes that value × Actual Loops to its parent; exclusive time = inclusive time − children's inclusive time. Tree times are never summed naively.
Notes are hints only: large sequential scans, row-estimate deviations and sort spills are flagged, but a sequential scan is not an error by itself. Plan-only output never invents runtime metrics.
Multi-statement plans are switchable; node count and tree depth limits apply and large files can be cancelled while parsing.
